_comment: The GitHub issue forms ErgoptiPlus opens (Debug > Report a bug, Suggest a feature). `file` names a form of .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/ and every id in `fields` must be one of its fields (tools/test/test-issue-templates.cjs); `fields` also declares the URL builder's field order and truncation order. Diagnostic reporters prefill the host-derived version, os and driver values and the compact approved report (markdown tables, no JSON block) in `report_field`, which is the last declared field so the budget cuts it first; a cut report ends with the truncation marker and one note saying the complete report is on the clipboard and in the saved file (share_policy.truncated_note_key of schema.json). The complete approved report is still copied and saved locally. `day_log_field` names the optional textarea where the user drops the redacted day log the app saved; it is never prefilled and so is not in `fields`. The repository comes from _shared/modules/updater/defaults.json, never from here. max_url_bytes bounds the percent-encoded URL, low enough for the login redirect of a signed-out click, which encodes it again (limits measured in tools/test/test-issue-templates.cjs). Built by _shared/ui/issue_link.js and its Lua and AHK ports.
